assertion_results.text: Data extraction identifies the ecosystem as RPM based on the library name (openssl-libs) and component context, not Cargo (Step 1 Ecosystem detection — read ecosystems from Ecosystem Mappings config)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md: 'Ecosystem: **RPM** (system package)'. 'Classification: system package -- 1 remediation task per affected stream (Konflux release repo fix only)'. 'Lock file: rpms.lock.yaml'. Correctly identifies RPM ecosystem, not Cargo.

assertion_results.text: Version impact table includes ALL versions from the 2.2.x stream supportability matrix (2.2.0 through 2.2.4) and uses rpms.lock.yaml data for version extraction (Step 2.3)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md includes all 5 versions from the 2.2.x stream: 2.2.0 (3.0.7-25.el9_3), 2.2.1 (3.0.7-27.el9_4), 2.2.2 (retag of 2.2.1), 2.2.3 (3.0.7-28.el9_4), 2.2.4 (3.0.7-28.el9_4). Also includes 2.1.x versions for cross-stream analysis. 'Source data: rpms.lock.yaml at each pinned tag from the supportability matrix.'

assertion_results.text: Dependency chain context identifies openssl-libs as present in rpms.lock.yaml and uses this to determine the package origin — the lock file presence is the primary classification signal (Step 2.3.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md dependency chain: 'rpms.lock.yaml: PRESENT -- explicit install'. 'Origin: explicit install (openssl-libs specified in rpms.lock.yaml / rpms.in.yaml)'. 'The rpms.lock.yaml classification (explicit install) is used as the sole determination of package origin.'

assertion_results.text: Remediation creates a single task for the Konflux release repo — not the two-task upstream backport + downstream propagation flow used for source dependency ecosystems (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation — system package path)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md: Only one task created, targeting Repository = 'rhtpa-release.0.4.z' (the Konflux release repo). Pre-Creation Checklist: 'Task count per stream: 1 task (RPM / system package ecosystem)'. No upstream backport task exists. Summary: 'Remediate CVE-2026-40215: update openssl-libs to 3.0.7-28.el9_4 (rhtpa-2.2)'.

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description follows task-description-template.md format with Repository, Target Branch, Description, Implementation Notes, and Acceptance Criteria sections — Files to Modify is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md task description contains: '## Repository' (rhtpa-release.0.4.z), '## Target Branch' (main), '## Description' (CVE details and affected versions), '## Implementation Notes' (origin, SBOM status, update instructions), '## Acceptance Criteria' (3 checkboxes). No '## Files to Modify' section is present.

assertion_results.text: The version impact output addresses SBOM verification in the dependency chain context — either noting that verification was skipped because cosign is not available or because external tools are prohibited, or presenting the SBOM classification result (Step 2.3.5 Optional SBOM verification)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md dependency chain: 'SBOM verification: skipped -- cosign not available'. Dedicated section '### SBOM Verification Status': 'SBOM verification was skipped -- cosign is not available in the current environment. The rpms.lock.yaml classification (explicit install) is used as the sole determination of package origin. No SBOM cross-validation was attempted.'
